feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 October 2026 4:44pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 02 October 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Active cold front clearing the Irish Sea area as high pressure builds to its rear.


##Wind##

South or southwest 6 or 7, veering west 4 or 5 this evening and occasionally 6 in the north, then decreasing 3 or 4 overnight. Backing west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate overnight, then slight later.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, clearing later this evening to become fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 overnight into Saturday, but force 3 towards Liverpool Bay until later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, patchy rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.
